custody_model: MyConstant centrally brokered and administered crypto-collateralized peer-to-peer loans between borrowers and investors, including platform control over matching, account balances, collateral processes, and repayment administration
yield_source: Interest paid by borrowers on crypto-collateralized loans and allocated to marketplace investors under product-specific terms
risk_notes: Investors faced borrower credit, collateral valuation, liquidation, platform, custody-interface, matching, servicing, regulatory, liquidity, withdrawal, and liquidation-process risks. The existence of collateral did not establish full protection or recovery.

custody_model: Customers transferred supported crypto assets into a centrally administered fixed-yield account whose underlying deployment, counterparties, segregation, and legal-title treatment are not fully established by the reviewed regulatory summaries
yield_source: Fixed yield represented as generated through MyConstant's lending and asset-deployment activities
risk_notes: Customers faced platform, counterparty, deployment, custody, segregation, liquidity, withdrawal, regulatory, rate, and liquidation risks. Fixed return language is not treated as principal protection or guaranteed recovery.

custody_model: Fiat funds were placed into a centrally administered fixed-return product; the reviewed sources do not establish deposit-insurance treatment, segregation, or the complete contractual borrower and counterparty chain
yield_source: Fixed return represented as arising from MyConstant's lending or related deployment of customer funds
risk_notes: Customers faced platform, lending, counterparty, legal-title, liquidity, withdrawal, regulatory, and liquidation risks. The product is not classified as an insured bank deposit from the reviewed evidence.

custody_model: Customers transferred crypto assets into an account administered by Plutus Lending LLC. The SEC alleged that the operator exercised discretion over deposited assets to generate income and fund interest payments; the settled case did not include an admission or denial of those allegations
yield_source: Income represented as generated by deploying customer crypto assets through lending and other income-producing activities, with interest credited to customers
risk_notes: Customers faced platform, discretionary deployment, counterparty, custody, segregation, liquidity, withdrawal, securities-law, state-licensing, rate, and wind-down risks. Product scale, withdrawal instructions, and regulatory settlements do not establish universal principal recovery.
